title: tricliceras lobatum
intro: Tricliceras lobatum, commonly known as the Lobate Tricliceras or Yellow Trumpet, is a plant species belonging to the family Passifloraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Tricliceras lobatum include exhibiting analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic activities, which contribute to its traditional use in folk medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is required to fully understand its effects.
